market_summary: Strong USD-driven liquidation across EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD during the London/NY overlap. All three symbols have experienced severe momentum flushes below session VWAP, EMA50, and their respective Value Area Lows. However, every pair is currently heavily stretched beyond its -2 ATR lower band and pressing into major session low support zones. Chasing shorts at these extended extremes poses unfavorable risk of sharp mean-reversion pullbacks, making HOLD the disciplined posture across all assets until pullbacks to EMA20/VWAP develop.

signals.rationale: 1) VP: Price is far below VAL (1.10780) and below POC (1.10943), confirming bearish expansion into low-volume territory. 2) CVD: CVD is -7,026 (NEUTRAL label) but displaying negative slope (-8,721.7). 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, high liquidity window. 4) Trend: Price trades well below downsloping VWAP (1.10844) and EMA50 (1.10850). 5) ATR: Extended below the lower ATR band (1.10634), showing severe downside stretch. 6) RVOL: RVOL is 1.01 (no yellow spike), showing momentum is beginning to stall near the lows. 7) Levels: Testing Session Low at 1.10533 with extended wicks on lower ATR boundary, indicating high risk of a mean-reversion snapback toward EMA20/VAL. Selling here would chase the extreme of an ATR extension.

signals.rationale: 1) VP: Price is heavily below VAL (1.32557) and POC (1.32731). 2) CVD: Strongly BEARISH at -15,307 with accelerating negative slope (-6,411.21), fully aligned with downtrend. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP provides prime momentum conditions. 4) Trend: Strong structural downtrend below VWAP (1.32620) and EMA50 (1.32625). 5) ATR: Price has blown out past the lower ATR band (1.32352), currently stretched at 1.32261. 6) RVOL: Normal volume on the latest bar (1.145) following prior high-volume climaxes. 7) Levels: Signal bar closed right near Session Low (1.32210). While momentum is decisively bearish, price is significantly overextended below -2 ATR band with high risk of mean-reversion shakeout before continuation; therefore chasing a short at the absolute bottom of the move warrants a HOLD until a pullback to EMA20 occurs.
